docker/Dockerfile.text:
FROM nvidia/cuda:12.6.1-devel-ubuntu24.04

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    VENV_PATH=/opt/archer-venv

# Base tooling for ML workloads (no Claude Code dependencies)
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    software-properties-common \
    git \
    wget \
    curl \
    ca-certificates \
    git-lfs \
    build-essential \
    pkg-config \
    libglib2.0-0 \
    libsm6 \
    libxrender1 \
    libxext6 \
    libssl-dev \
    libffi-dev \
    ninja-build \
    less \
    procps \
    sudo \
    vim && \
    add-apt-repository ppa:deadsnakes/ppa -y && \
    apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    python3.10 \
    python3.10-dev \
    python3.10-venv && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Create a clean Python 3.10 virtual environment for Archer
RUN python3.10 -m venv ${VENV_PATH}
ENV PATH=${VENV_PATH}/bin:$PATH

COPY archer-requirements.txt /tmp/archer-requirements.txt

RUN python -m pip install --no-cache-dir --upgrade pip setuptools wheel && \
    python -m pip install --no-cache-dir torch==2.5.1 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu124 && \
    wget -nv https://github.com/Dao-AILab/flash-attention/releases/download/v2.7.3/flash_attn-2.7.3+cu12torch2.5cxx11abiFALSE-cp310-cp310-linux_x86_64.whl -O /tmp/flash_attn-2.7.3+cu12torch2.5cxx11abiFALSE-cp310-cp310-linux_x86_64.whl && \
    python -m pip install --no-cache-dir /tmp/flash_attn-2.7.3+cu12torch2.5cxx11abiFALSE-cp310-cp310-linux_x86_64.whl && \
    rm -f /tmp/flash_attn-2.7.3+cu12torch2.5cxx11abiFALSE-cp310-cp310-linux_x86_64.whl && \
    python -m pip install --no-cache-dir -r /tmp/archer-requirements.txt

# Build arguments for user creation
ARG LDAP_USERNAME
ARG LDAP_GROUPNAME
ARG LDAP_UID
ARG LDAP_GID

# Create local user and group
RUN groupadd ${LDAP_GROUPNAME} --gid ${LDAP_GID} && \
    useradd -m -U -s /bin/bash -G ${LDAP_GROUPNAME},sudo -u ${LDAP_UID} ${LDAP_USERNAME} && \
    echo "${LDAP_USERNAME} ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL" >> /etc/sudoers

# Do not chown shared /scratch paths during image build (can fail on PVC/root-squash)
RUN mkdir -p /workspace && \
    chown -R ${LDAP_USERNAME}:${LDAP_GROUPNAME} /workspace

USER ${LDAP_USERNAME}
WORKDIR /scratch/cvlab/home/shuli
CMD ["bash"]

docker/Dockerfile.asft.text:
FROM registry.rcp.epfl.ch/shuli/archer:latest

# Switch to root to install into the shared venv (base image ends with USER shuli)
USER root

# Install ASFT-specific extra dependencies
COPY asft-extra-requirements.txt /tmp/asft-extra-requirements.txt
RUN python -m pip install --no-cache-dir -r /tmp/asft-extra-requirements.txt && \
    python -m pip install --no-cache-dir torch==2.5.1 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu124 && \
    rm -f /tmp/asft-extra-requirements.txt

USER shuli

LINEAGE-final/docker/Dockerfile.text:
ARG BASE_IMAGE=vllm/vllm-openai:v0.11.0
FROM ${BASE_IMAGE}

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive \
    PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false

RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
      build-essential \
      ca-certificates \
      git \
      util-linux \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    && ln -sf "$(command -v python3)" /usr/local/bin/python

# Keep the image generic. Research code, Python packages, and pinned evaluator
# checkouts live on the PVC and can change without rebuilding this image.
WORKDIR /workspace
ENTRYPOINT []
CMD ["bash"]
